text.en: All Classic World servers offline. Forgotten Hollow, the new Zenith world and the monthly Windows update.
text.he: כל השרתים של Classic World סגורים. Forgotten Hollow, העולם החדש Zenith ועדכון Windows החודשי.

title.en: November update: Forgotten Hollow + Zenith world
title.he: עדכון נובמבר: Forgotten Hollow והעולם Zenith

text.en: New area for level 39+, 34 quests, field boss Rotten Mushmom (Lv. 60), new weapons, Crafting Lv. 9 and a second world, Zenith.
text.he: אזור חדש לרמה 39+, 34 משימות, הבוס Rotten Mushmom (רמה 60), נשקים חדשים, Crafting רמה 9 ועולם שני, Zenith.

title.he: The New Journey Begins (מסע חדש מתחיל)

text.en: Daily check-in rewards, tracked per world. Progress from the launch event does not carry over.
text.he: פרסי כניסה יומיים, לכל עולם בנפרד. ההתקדמות מאירוע ההשקה לא עוברת.

text.en: Grandma Benson's pie event, with harvest furniture among the rewards. Ingredients expire when it ends.
text.he: אירוע הפאי של סבתא בנסון, עם רהיטי קציר בין הפרסים. המצרכים פגים בסוף האירוע.

text.en: Escaped turkeys across Maple World, with rewards for catching one.
text.he: תרנגולי הודו שברחו ברחבי העולם, עם פרס למי שתופס.

title.en: Moon Bunny Rice Cake party quest
title.he: משימת הקבוצה של ארנב הירח (עוגות אורז)

text.en: 3-player party quest from Tory in Henesys. Windia: channels 20-30, Zenith: channels 7-10.
text.he: משימה ל-3 שחקנים אצל Tory ב-Henesys. Windia: ערוצים 20-30, Zenith: ערוצים 7-10.

title.en: Mystery Hair and Face Coupons: new styles
title.he: קופוני שיער ופנים מסתוריים: סגנונות חדשים

text.en: Cash Shop: six new hair and six new face styles per gender.
text.he: Cash Shop: שישה סגנונות שיער ושישה פנים חדשים לכל מין.

text.en: New outfits and a Black Friday Mystery Fashion Crate. End date in Nexon's post.
text.he: בגדים חדשים וקופסת אופנה מסתורית לבלאק פריידיי. תאריך הסיום בפוסט של נקסון.

text.en: Guilds (formed in Lith Harbor), a Forgotten Hollow party quest and a returning Christmas town. Usually comes with a maintenance that morning (US time).
text.he: גילדות (נוצרות ב-Lith Harbor), משימת קבוצה ב-Forgotten Hollow ועיר חג המולד חוזרת. בדרך כלל מגיע עם תחזוקה בבוקר (שעון ארה"ב).

title.en: Test server for the 3rd job advancement

text.en: The Mystery Fashion Crate started a new set of pieces from fourteen outfits until 18 November, among them teddy bear, bunny, pajama, snowboard and school uniform sets, and the Halloween Mystery Fashion Crate ended.
The v1.2.0 patch stopped Megaphones from being used during the 96-hour Cash item trade restriction that follows an account's first NX purchase, and improved bot detection.

The v1.1.0 patch stopped players in debt from picking up other players' drops, lowered the HP of Copper Drake, Tortie, Clang and Drake, strengthened Focus, Poison Breath and Thunder Bolt, made Woodcrafting's arrow conversions turn 100 arrows into 50 instead of 10 into 5, and fixed eleven bugs.

The Halloween events announced in the Grand Launch notes opened on 28 October 2026 and run until 18 November: Malady's Halloween Candies quest, its hidden mission with the Pumpkin Basket as reward, and Orange Slimes in four towns.
The Cash Shop added the Halloween Mystery Fashion Crate until 4 November and gave the Mystery Hair Coupon and Mystery Face Coupon a new set of styles until 11 November.
The day after the Grand Launch, an unscheduled maintenance added the Debt System against real money trading, worked on server stability and fixed two bugs.

MapleStory Classic World opened to everyone at version 1.0.0, adding Housing in Henesys and Kerning City, the Excavation Site in Perion, The Murky Swamp II, the boss Stumpy and launch events, and strengthening Swordsman and Magician recovery and Iron Body.

A minor patch added Korean as a display language, placed the Maple Administrator in Kerning City, reshaped Kerning City around its Civic Center and fixed over twenty bugs, among them several disconnects and Steal working on missed attacks.
An unscheduled maintenance cut the price shops pay for Coconut, fixed two problems with the Cleric skill Heal and restored access to channels 1 to 4.

Early Access, which Nexon called Founder's Access, opened MapleStory Classic World at version 0.9.0 to Founder's Package owners two weeks before the Grand Launch, with Maple Island and Victoria Island, the four jobs up to their 2nd advancement, a level cap of 100, Crafting, Citizenship and the Beaut
